description: Vercel AI SDK v7 generateText with an Anthropic prompt marked for cache.
notes: ai 7.0.162 does not emit spans. Spans come from @ai-sdk/otel OpenTelemetry, passed on telemetry.integrations. allowSystemInMessages is set because v7 otherwise rejects a system message in messages. The system message sets providerOptions.anthropic.cacheControl to ephemeral. Scripted usage is input 2100, output 40, cache_read 1800, cache_write 200. gen_ai.usage.input_tokens is the inclusive 2100, cache_read.input_tokens is 1800, and cache_creation.input_tokens is 200. The default integration does not write providerMetadata, and the cache write is still present as a usage attribute.
